title: Teams-Hintergrund Generator
slide_intent: Make personalization predictable so names and organizational identity remain readable across backgrounds.
strategic_value: A controlled generator can give DB employees individual identification within a consistent template.
demonstration: A large background preview sits left of controls for image, logo extension, name and designation; PNG and JPG export buttons appear below the preview.
practical_value: Prepare a quiet left text area and a 16:9 image before adding employee details.

content_islands.name: Preview and export
content_islands.spec: Show the sample background with DB mark, name and designation at left, with two export options below.

content_islands.name: Configuration controls
content_islands.spec: Arrange image upload, logo-extension choices and personal text fields in the right column.

reference_purposes.Application: The generator demonstrates a background populated with name and role and exposes PNG/JPG export.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The interface states a 16:9 crop, recommends at least 1920×1080 px and asks for a quiet left text area.

ingredient.name: Teams background
ingredient.role: Identify the participant and organization without cluttering the camera view.
ingredient.application: Use a 16:9 background, ideally at least 1920×1080 px, with a calm area behind the left text.
ingredient.scope: This applies to the displayed Teams-background generator; the pixel size is an ideal, not a universal minimum.
